commentary: Market breadth is decidedly defensive with breadthScore at 44 and the deterministic gate flashing WEAK. The Nifty 50's sharp break below 22,780 on institutional distribution aligns with William O'Neil's classic market-in-correction rules. Stan Weinstein's stage analysis mandates strict capital preservation when benchmark averages slip beneath critical short-term moving averages amid macro tremors. Although selective Stage 2 candidates are demonstrating remarkable relative strength and coiling into textbook bases, Jesse Livermore's core discipline dictates never fighting the general tide. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules require keeping pilot trades small, enforcing rigid stop losses, and demanding immediate traction, keeping the bulk of capital safe until institutional accumulation returns to the broader market.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis Frameworks

AAATECH.technical: Price cleared its 20-day pivot on extraordinary 10.93x average volume, pushing RSI to 64 with MACD above zero. While short-term momentum is robust, longer-term relative strength against broader indices remains unproven within an emerging base structure.
AAATECH.fundamental: Top-line growth of 1.6% YoY and single-digit EPS expansion fail CANSLIM benchmarks. Subdued 10.1% ROE, 8.9% ROCE, low promoter holding at 34.4%, and recent top management turnover reflect absent institutional quality.
AAATECH.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below the 91.81 stop. Violating the 20-day pivot invalidates breakout volume conviction.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructed a double bottom with a 26.6% deep cup and 5.7% handle, maintaining support above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 65 shows constructive price action, though overhead supply looms near multi-month highs.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Dismal fundamental profile with sales plunging 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.6%. Razor-thin operating margins near 2-3%, weak 3.1% ROE, and declining promoter stake violate core CANSLIM investment filters.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails if price breaches 95.61. Deteriorating fundamentals offer zero cushion if the double-bottom neckline gives way.

ACE.technical: Exhibits a textbook double bottom within Stage 2, forming a shallow 12.8% cup with a tight 4.4% handle. Trading comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with positive MACD, reflecting sustained institutional accumulation.
ACE.fundamental: Solid industrial momentum with operational revenue expanding 19.5% and EPS up 22.3% YoY. Dominant 60%+ crane market share, expanding EBITDA margins at 20.5%, and negligible leverage provide durable operational support.
ACE.risk: Breakdown below 1189.87 invalidates the handle pivot. Strict stop discipline is vital given broad market industrial weakness.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Constructed a resilient double bottom above key moving averages, absorbing general market weakness with RSI holding firm at 61 and MACD expanding positively. Base depth is orderly, signaling accumulation in a high-beta renewable leader.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Exceptional operational acceleration with Q1 revenue jumping 67.8% YoY and net profit up 64.8%. Strong operating margins above 80% reflect aggressive utility-scale solar execution, though capital intensity keeps debt levels elevated.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Thesis fails on a breach of the 436.83 stop. High capital leverage increases volatility if market risk-off persists.

ADVANCE.technical: Coiling tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on expanding 1.99x volume. Holding firmly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, the pattern displays characteristic volatility contraction with RSI at 57.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Blockbuster operational performance with Q1 revenues surging 95.9% and PAT climbing 152.2% YoY. Healthy 19.6% ROCE, 17.2% ROE, and manageable debt validate rapid market-share gains across its agrochemical portfolio.
ADVANCE.risk: Violating the 130.78 swing stop invalidates the pivot base. Lack of immediate volume expansion triggers fast exit.

AETHER.technical: Clear SEPA breakout to new 52-week highs on massive 8.13x volume, comfortably clearing resistance above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Displays textbook leadership relative strength while major indices suffer distribution.
AETHER.fundamental: High-margin CRAMS and exclusive contract manufacturing drove 27.3% revenue growth and 33.1% EPS expansion YoY. Clean balance sheet with minimal debt (D/E 0.14) and 0% promoter pledge confirm institutional sponsorship.
AETHER.risk: Break below 1596.97 breaks the breakout bar low. Strict Minervini cut-loss discipline protects capital against institutional distribution.
